Level 4 - Advanced 55 min Machine-coding case study Patterns: State, Strategy, Command, Mediator, Observer

Elevator System

The classic "design an elevator" round, built so it actually runs: each car is a small state machine, the decision "keep going or turn around" is a pluggable LOOK or SCAN policy, the decision "which car answers this button" is a pluggable dispatch strategy, every button press is a command object, and one controller thread is the only code that changes car state. You get a simulation you can test tick by tick, including safety, starvation and 800 concurrent button presses.
